overview.en:
Skill for looking up DeFi protocol TVL, chain stats, and ranking via the free DeFi Llama API.

Review public DeFi totals and rankings with a clear chain or protocol scope. Keep the reporting time and measurement definition visible when comparing values.

Use this plugin in a Ghast conversation with the relevant inputs or project context. The bundled workflow guides the task; any required external tools or runtime must be available in your environment.
overview.zh-CN:
查询 DeFi 协议锁仓量、链上统计与排行榜。

在明确链或协议范围后查看公开 DeFi 统计与排名，比较时保留统计时间和指标定义。

在 Ghast 对话中提供相关输入或项目背景后使用本插件。随附流程会指导任务；所需外部工具或运行环境仍需在本机可用。

starterPrompts.en: Compare the available TVL data for these three DeFi protocols.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这三个 DeFi 协议的可用 TVL 数据。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the TVL rankings for the selected chain.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总选定链上的 TVL 排名。

starterPrompts.en: Explain this protocol's available TVL figures and their reporting time.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 解释这个协议的可用 TVL 数据及统计时间。
